content.text: Stats window is capped at 7 days, so I'll query in two pieces.

The Back-to-School campaign finished at the end of Tuesday, August 10 (Dublin time) and delivered 195 link clicks. It spent $356.86 of the $400.00 budget, so $43.14 was left unspent.

| | Spend (USD) | Impressions | Link clicks |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ad group A (posts 2214148860933722322 and 2214511248799313528) | $179.30 | 206,671 | 97 |
| Ad group B (posts 2214330054866267849 and 2214692442733464310) | $177.56 | 202,153 | 98 |
| **Total** | **$356.86** | **408,824** | **195** |

- **Cost:** That works out to about $1.83 per link click.
- **Setup:** I ran one campaign with two ad groups, each promoting two of your approved posts and linking to brackenhold.ie/trial. Both targeted Ireland and the UK on iPhone and Android only, with automatic bidding and a $16 daily cap.
- **Results:** The two ad groups performed almost identically, and so did the four posts. I found no clear winner, so I never shifted budget or paused anything.
- **Trial starts:** X can't see trial starts without the pixel, so I can't report them. Please compare your own trial-start numbers with the 195 clicks.
- **Status:** Both ad groups reached their end time (midnight Irish time on August 11), so nothing is spending now. I didn't write any new posts.

Go raibh maith agat, and good luck with the autumn intake!
